abstract.p: We present our system developed for the Question-and-Answer in Islamic Studies Assessment Shared Task on Evaluating LLMs for Islamic Knowledge (QIAS 2025), which focuses on answering Arabic multiple-choice questions (MCQs) derived from classical Islamic texts. Our methodology integrates fewshot chain-of-thought prompting across multiple LLMs, enhanced by a majority-vote ensemble mechanism. In situations of ensemble uncertainty, we deploy a retrieval-augmented re-prompting module that extracts contextually relevant passages from digitized Islamic sources to refine model predictions. Our final system achieves an accuracy of 89.8% on the hidden test set.
